nearMissesRefusedByRole.finding: The offence table's venue column is named `City or County`, and the shared field semantics binds that name to the participant's own city. Left to the name channel the participant's home town would have been written into the column asking where the offence was prosecuted. Refused by role before rendering.

The offence table's last column is named `Case Number` and binds the matter's case number. Writing it would have put one value into the first offence row beside five empty cells — a row that reads as finished and is not — on a form whose own instructions say an incomplete application is returned. Refused by role.

Both `Home Telephone Number` and `Work Telephone Number` bind participant.phone. The platform holds one unqualified contact number, so writing it would have put the same number in two boxes asking different questions and asserted it was a home number in the first. All three phone boxes are refused and carried to the participant.
